claims.quote: Brochis delphax, long known as Corydoras delphax, is an armoured catfish from the Río Inírida and other parts of the upper Orinoco basin in Colombia.
Has been recorded from the Río Inírida and other parts of the upper Orinoco basins in western Colombia.
